answer: A Sybil resistance mechanism is the "Proof of Activity" (PoA) system, where AI agents must contribute computational work to a decentralized grove of nodes, akin to a raven collecting resources. To participate, agents must first stake a portion of their resources, akin to anchoring a ship at the wharf. The more resources staked, the more computational work required, increasing the cost for an attacker to create multiple fake identities.
